tools.name: xr_get_session_status
tools.title: Get XR session status
tools.description: Report XR session + device status: device name, whether a session is offered/active, session mode, enabled features, and visibility. Call this first to orient.

tools.name: xr_accept_session
tools.title: Accept XR session
tools.description: Accept an offered XR session (equivalent to the user clicking "Enter XR"). Then poll xr_get_session_status until sessionActive is true.

tools.name: xr_end_session
tools.title: End XR session
tools.description: End the active XR session.

tools.name: xr_get_transform
tools.title: Get device transform
tools.description: Get the position, orientation (quaternion), and euler angles of a tracked device. Gaze reports the headset-derived origin and its world orientation.

tools.name: xr_set_transform
tools.title: Set device transform
tools.description: Set a device position and/or orientation immediately (XR-origin). Gaze accepts orientation only; move its origin with the headset. Hands: `anchor` puts that point of the hand at `position` and keeps it there while the hand changes shape (e.g. anchor "index-tip" on a button, "grasp" on an object before pinching); orientation may be hand directions or "auto". Requires an active session.

tools.name: xr_look_at
tools.title: Look at a point
tools.description: Orient a device toward an XR-origin-relative world point. Optionally move it to a given distance from the target; gaze does not support moving its origin. Requires an active session.

tools.name: xr_animate_to
tools.title: Animate device pose
tools.description: Animate a device to a target position and/or orientation (XR-origin) over `duration` seconds (default 0.5), from where it is when the animation starts. Gaze accepts orientation only. Hands take `anchor` and hand directions as in xr_set_transform. easing "minimum-jerk" moves like a person (default "linear"). For multi-step hand interactions (press, grab, carry, gestures) prefer xr_run_sequence. Requires an active, rendering session.

tools.name: xr_set_input_mode
tools.title: Set input mode
tools.description: Switch the primary input between motion controllers and hand tracking.

tools.name: xr_set_connected
tools.title: Connect/disconnect input
tools.description: Connect or disconnect a controller, hand, or gaze source.

tools.name: xr_get_select_value
tools.title: Get select value
tools.description: Get the current select value (controller trigger or hand pinch), 0..1.

tools.name: xr_set_select_value
tools.title: Set select value
tools.description: Set the select value (trigger/pinch), 0..1, optionally ramping from the current value over `duration` seconds (easing default minimum-jerk). A hand pinch selects at 0.9 and lets go at 0.7; a trigger selects above 0. Use xr_select for a full press+release.

tools.name: xr_select
tools.title: Select (press + release)
tools.description: Perform a full select gesture: selectstart on press, then select and selectend on release, holding `duration` seconds (default 0.15). A hand closes its pinch over 0.1 s before the hold and opens it over 0.1 s after. Requires an active session.

tools.name: xr_get_gamepad_state
tools.title: Get gamepad state
tools.description: Get all buttons/axes for a controller (index 0=trigger, 1=squeeze, 2=thumbstick, 3=A/X, 4=B/Y, 5=thumbrest; axes 0=stick-x, 1=stick-y).

tools.name: xr_set_gamepad_state
tools.title: Set gamepad state
tools.description: Set controller buttons and/or thumbstick axes by index.

tools.name: xr_get_device_state
tools.title: Get device state
tools.description: Get a full snapshot: headset pose, input mode, controllers, hands (with poseId and pinchValue), gaze, stereo, and FOV. Positions are XR-origin relative.

tools.name: xr_set_device_state
tools.title: Set device state
tools.description: Apply a partial device state (positions XR-origin; hands also take poseId and pinchValue). Call with no `state` to reset everything to defaults.

tools.name: xr_set_hand_pose
tools.title: Set hand pose
tools.description: Set a named hand pose on a hand device. Poses only shape the hand; to pinch (select), use the pinch value (xr_set_select_value). Poses: default (relaxed), pinch (thumb and index touching), point (index extended), open (high five), flat (fingers together, blade), fist (closed fist), thumbs-up (fist with thumb up), finger-gun (index and thumb out), peace (V sign), three (index, middle, ring up), four (four fingers up, thumb folded), ok (thumb-index circle), rock (index and pinky out), call (thumb and pinky out), pinch-middle (thumb to middle tip), pinch-ring (thumb to ring tip), pinch-pinky (thumb to pinky tip), tripod (thumb, index, middle tips together), key-pinch (thumb against side of index), microgesture (loose curl, thumb by the side of the index), grip (wrapped around a handle), claw (holding a ball), hook (carrying a bag handle), cup (scooping water). Optionally take individual fingers from other poses, e.g. poseId "open" with fingers {"middle":"fist","ring":"fist","pinky":"fist"}, or blend partway with {"poseId":"fist","weight":0.5}. Setting a pose clears earlier finger overrides. `duration` fades from the hand as shown (easing default minimum-jerk); a hand placed by an anchor keeps the anchor in place.

tools.name: xr_microgesture
tools.title: Make a microgesture
tools.description: Swipe or tap the thumb on the side of the curled index finger, as on Quest. The app sees the hand gamepad (xr-standard) button pressed for 35 ms when the gesture completes: 5 swipe-left, 6 swipe-right, 7 swipe-forward, 8 swipe-backward, 9 tap; no select events. A hand not in the "microgesture" pose takes it first (0.25 s); a hand that is selecting must let go first. Raise the hand side-on in view first, e.g. xr_set_transform with anchor "wrist" and orientation {fingers:[0,-0.6,-0.8],palm:"left"} (right hand; "right" for the left). Requires an active session and hand input.

tools.name: xr_get_hand_state
tools.title: Get hand state
tools.description: Read a hand: pose, finger blends, a pose fade in progress, pinch value, whether select is pressed, its anchor pin, and XR-origin positions of the wrist, grip, grasp point, index tip and thumb tip, plus its finger/palm/thumb directions (joints:"all" adds every joint).

tools.name: xr_run_sequence
tools.title: Run a hand sequence
tools.description: Run a whole hand interaction in one call with natural motion: one smooth arc per move, the head turning to each target first, the body leaning or stepping closer when needed, the other hand resting by the hip. Steps run in order and each step's properties animate together. Positions are XR-origin metres; -Z is forward, +Y up. Resolves when done with the select events the app saw, step times, press contact times, warnings and the final hand state. Rules: press buttons with `press`, not a pinch. To pick something up, target it with `pinch:{value:1,at:"arrival"}` (the grasp point, between thumb and index, goes on the target). While holding, targeting a surface sets the object down on it; let go with pinch 0. The anchor carries over to later steps. A thumbs up is poseId "thumbs-up" with orientation {fingers:"forward",thumb:"up"} at a head-relative position. A microgesture is a step of its own, {"microgesture":"swipe-left"}, with the hand raised in view and the pinch open (see xr_microgesture). Get names from xr_list_targets and check a plan with dryRun:true first. Example: {"device":"hand-right","steps":[{"label":"reach","target":"button","press":{}},{"label":"grab","target":"piece","approach":{"distance":0.06},"pinch":{"value":1,"at":"arrival"}},{"label":"carry","target":"tray","depart":{"distance":0.08},"approach":{"distance":0.06}},{"label":"release","pinch":0,"duration":0.15},{"label":"thumbs up","position":{"relativeTo":"head","x":0.12,"y":-0.35,"z":-0.35},"anchor":"wrist","orientation":{"fingers":"forward","thumb":"up"},"poseId":"thumbs-up"},{"label":"hold","duration":1}]}

tools.name: xr_cancel_sequence
tools.title: Cancel a hand sequence
tools.description: Stop the running xr_run_sequence where it is; that call returns with cancelled: true and the steps done. The pinch is left as it is (no select events).

tools.name: xr_list_targets
tools.title: List sequence targets
tools.description: List the named targets xr_run_sequence steps can use, from the page's target resolver: name, box centre and size (XR-origin). resolver:false means the page has none; use positions.

tools.name: xr_get_world_state
tools.title: Get world state
tools.description: Summarize the emulated environment (SEM): plane/mesh counts and the list of tracked objects with semantic labels. Requires the Synthetic Environment Module.

tools.name: xr_get_objects
tools.title: Get tracked objects
tools.description: List the SEM tracked planes/meshes with their semantic labels (e.g. wall, floor, table).

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot the browser tab
tools.description: Capture the visible browser tab — the composited frame the developer sees — as an image. Serviced by the extension (captureVisibleTab), so it works on any page regardless of how the WebXR scene is rendered. Defaults to a downscaled JPEG to stay within model image limits; override maxWidth/format/quality if needed.
